payload.title: Accessibility & localization
payload.description: From hardening spec (1367-1419). Accessibility contract: accessible names for icons, keyboard nav (web), focus management (modals/drawers), dynamic type/text scaling (iOS/Android), color contrast, reduced motion, screen-reader labels. Localization hooks for reusable components and error-code messages. Partially addressed by the design system but no explicit a11y/l10n contract or tests yet. Size: M.
